jobs.title: Associate Creative Director - Design
jobs.description:
Description
 
  

   The Associate Creative Director leads the development and execution of creative strategy and visual direction for integrated fundraising and engagement campaigns across print and digital channels. This role partners with creative leadership, strategists, copywriters, designers, and account teams to translate client objectives into compelling campaign concepts that drive donor response and strengthen brand impact. The Associate Creative Director provides creative leadership on key accounts, mentors members of the Creative team, and ensures high-quality creative output across multiple projects while meeting client objectives and production timelines.
 
 

    Key Responsibilities
 

 
  Lead the creative development and visual direction for integrated fundraising campaigns across direct mail, digital, and emerging channels.
  Translate strategic briefs into compelling creative concepts that support client goals and donor engagement.
  Apply AI-powered creative tools responsibly (e.g., generative image/copy and ideation assistants) to accelerate concepting and production while safeguarding brand integrity, originality, and ethical/appropriate use.
  Provide creative leadership and direction to designers and art directors to ensure cohesive campaign execution.
  Collaborate closely with copywriters, strategists, and account teams to develop innovative and effective campaign ideas.
  Review and provide feedback on creative work to maintain high standards of quality, brand alignment, and strategic impact.
  Present creative concepts and campaign strategies to internal teams and clients with clear rationale.
  Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while ensuring timelines and deliverables are met.
  Contribute to the evolution of creative strategy, campaign innovation, and best practices within the organization.
  Stay current on creative trends, nonprofit fundraising strategies, digital marketing, and emerging AI capabilities.
  Performs other related duties as assigned by management.
 
 
  Supervisory Responsibilities:
 
 
 
 
  Provides guidance and creative direction to members of the Creative team and freelance creative resources as needed. May assist in mentoring, coaching, and developing members of the creative team.
  Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
 
 
 

    Qualifications
 
  
 Education & Experience:
  

 
 
  Bachelor’s Degree (BA) in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field from a four-year college or university.
  7–10 years of professional experience in art direction, design, or creative leadership, preferably in an agency or in-house creative environment; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  Preferred experience includes nonprofit fundraising, direct response marketing, and integrated campaign development across print and digital channels.
 
 
  
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  

 
 
  Strong knowledge of visual design principles including layout, typography, brand identity, and integrated campaign development.
  Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and familiarity with modern digital design tools and platforms.
  Working knowledge of generative AI design and content tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them in donor-focused client work.
  Deep understanding of integrated marketing and donor-focused creative strategy.
  Ability to translate client objectives and strategic briefs into compelling creative concepts and campaign direction.
  Strong creative leadership and ability to guide and mentor designers and art directors.
  Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate creative strategy and rationale to internal teams and clients.
  Strong problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities.
  High attention to detail and commitment to quality creative execution.
 
 
 
  Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At AGP we strive to build a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. If you think this role sounds like you, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification or skill in the description, please apply! You could be just the person we are looking for to fill this, or other, roles!

   We are friendly, smart, curious and passionate about what we do! Working here, you will also enjoy:

  Flexible PTO Policy + Paid Parental Leave
  401k and company match
  Oh, and don’t forget - You're working with clients who are making a positive difference in the world.

  AGP partners with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to inspire action, deepen relationships, and grow with confidence. As a fully integrated growth partner, we bring together strategy, fundraising, marketing, technology, and analytics to build momentum that lasts.

jobs.description:
Associate Creative Director, Brand




About MVR Digital

We’re a performance marketing agency for premium and luxury DTC brands. We run Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV for companies where the work has to look as good as it performs. Adweek named us one of the fastest growing agencies. We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and Toronto.




The role

Our creative team produces performance work at volume and does it well. We need the person who gives that volume a spine: someone who defines a brand’s architecture, tells its story to the client, and leads the designers building inside it.

You’ll own brand for one of our largest accounts from day one. You’ll direct the creative team assigned to it, partner with our Creative Director on the agency’s broader creative standards, and be the voice on client calls when brand work is on the table. The role expands across the roster as you build capacity.




What you’ll do


Define brand architecture. Map how product lines, campaigns, and channels relate. Write the system: hierarchy, voice, visual rules, and where each applies. Hand designers something they can build inside without asking you every time.Lead the account’s creative team. Set direction, review work, give feedback that makes people better, and own the quality of what ships. You’ll manage two to four designers.Tell the brand’s story to the client. Build the narrative before you build the deck. On calls, explain the concept, show the paths you rejected, and tie every choice to what the work has to do.Own brand and presentation design. Pitch decks, brand site modules, event and booth materials, campaign concepts.Keep the brand coherent across surfaces. When the ads, the deck, and the trade show booth look like three companies made them, that’s yours to fix.Push brand evolution. Clients want their brand to move forward but rarely say it. Read that and bring options before they ask.Connect brand and performance. Work with media and creative strategists so the brand system and the ad output move together.



What we’re looking for

Seven or more years in brand design or art direction, with at least two directing other designers.A portfolio that leads with brand systems, architecture, and presentation work, not static ads.You’ve presented your own work to clients and held your position under pressure without getting defensive.You can write a brand narrative, not just design one.Fluent in Figma & in the Adobe suite.Experience with premium, luxury, or high AOV DTC brands. You understand why a $400 product needs different treatment than a $40 one.You work well remote. You communicate in writing, close loops, and don’t need checking on.
Our values

Act like an owner. Clarity over complexity. Serve clients’ best interest. We win together, we lose together. Data-informed, human-led.

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Motion Design
jobs.description:
Company DescriptionIt all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 

Job DescriptionThe ServiceNow Brand Strategy and Creative team is a passionate group of creative thinkers responsible for shaping the future of the ServiceNow brand. We're looking for an Associate Creative Director of Motion Design to help define and evolve how our brand moves—across every channel and touchpoint, internal and external. 

In this role, you are both a maker and a leader, a designer and animator with expert command of motion and design principles including keyframes, timing, and visual systems. You demonstrate strong ownership and are fueled by a passion to create beautifully animated work. You are adept at interpreting the core objectives of the brief and can translate them into non-linear creative solutions that deliver for the customer with bias for action.  You are a strategic thinker and bring a point of view to your work providing clear, effective direction to artists and agencies. You field and reconcile feedback from leadership with judgment and composure, staying sharp under pressure while managing multiple workstreams. You bring a growth mindset that thrives in ambiguity and welcomes new ways of working.  

Reporting to the Creative Director of Motion Design and partnering with brand leadership, you'll lead creative development and execution across some of our highest impact brand events and initiatives. You invite collaboration and partner closely with internal teams, freelancers, and external agencies to bring world-class motion design to life. 

Responsibilities:

Own motion design projects end-to-end, from brief through delivery, across major brand initiatives, campaigns, and tier-one events- driving them independently while keeping the creative director and leadership updated. 

Bring a strong creative point of view to every workstream, helping to define the vision, and setting the standard for executional excellence. 

Design and animate directly, especially for key initiatives that require hands-on creative leadership. 

Maintain and evolve our brand motion language, ensuring consistency and craft across events, market launches, and core brand touchpoints. Scale motion systems and workflows by contributing to standards, templates, toolkits, and best practices. 

Manage multiple projects and programs in parallel, staying composed and effective under pressure and tight deadlines. 

Field and reconcile feedback from leadership, exercising judgment to translate input into a clear creative path forward. 

Direct, mentor, and provide clear, effective direction and feedback to motion designers, freelancers, and agency partners, raising the bar across all motion output. 

Partner cross-functionally with brand, marketing, product, and creative teams to align motion work with broader storytelling and business goals. 

Communicate effectively across creative peers, project management, strategy, senior leadership, and business partners, aligning stakeholders around a creative vision and knowing when to ask the right questions. 

Explore and integrate AI-driven tools and techniques to expand what's possible and improve how the team works. 

Qualifications10+ years of experience in motion design and creative direction, including prior leadership running workstreams and directing others. A strong creative point of view, with the ability to field and reconcile leadership feedback and provide clear direction to others.  

A portfolio that demonstrates strong design and typography fundamentals, a range of styles, and a diversity of project types. 

Mastery of motion and design principles, timing, keyframes, and visual systems, with fluency in speed and value curves. 

Expert knowledge of relevant tools, including After Effects, Cinema 4D, Redshift, and Figma, along with modern motion workflows. 

Experience working on tier-one brand moments such as global events, major campaigns, or product launches. 

Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Can develop project and initiative presentations from strategy to execution. Able to align stakeholders around a creative vision and ask smart questions that move work forward. 

Proven ability to run multiple projects and programs in parallel, prioritize effectively, and deliver under pressure and tight deadlines. Strong time management and composure across competing priorities. 

Demonstrated people management experience, coaching and developing team members and directing contractors and external agencies. 

Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into creative processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $155,400 - $272,000, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Brand
jobs.description:
Associate Creative Director, Brand


 


 

    About MVR Digital


 We’re a performance marketing agency for premium and luxury DTC brands. We run Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV for companies where the work has to look as good as it performs. Adweek named us one of the fastest growing agencies. We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and Toronto.


 


 

    The role


 Our creative team produces performance work at volume and does it well. We need the person who gives that volume a spine: someone who defines a brand’s architecture, tells its story to the client, and leads the designers building inside it.


 You’ll own brand for one of our largest accounts from day one. You’ll direct the creative team assigned to it, partner with our Creative Director on the agency’s broader creative standards, and be the voice on client calls when brand work is on the table. The role expands across the roster as you build capacity.


 


 

    What you’ll do


 

 
  

    Define brand architecture. Map how product lines, campaigns, and channels relate. Write the system: hierarchy, voice, visual rules, and where each applies. Hand designers something they can build inside without asking you every time.
  Lead the account’s creative team. Set direction, review work, give feedback that makes people better, and own the quality of what ships. You’ll manage two to four designers.
  Tell the brand’s story to the client. Build the narrative before you build the deck. On calls, explain the concept, show the paths you rejected, and tie every choice to what the work has to do.
  Own brand and presentation design. Pitch decks, brand site modules, event and booth materials, campaign concepts.
  Keep the brand coherent across surfaces. When the ads, the deck, and the trade show booth look like three companies made them, that’s yours to fix.
  Push brand evolution. Clients want their brand to move forward but rarely say it. Read that and bring options before they ask.
  Connect brand and performance. Work with media and creative strategists so the brand system and the ad output move together.
 
 

 


  What we’re looking for


 
  Seven or more years in brand design or art direction, with at least two directing other designers.
  A portfolio that leads with brand systems, architecture, and presentation work, not static ads.
  You’ve presented your own work to clients and held your position under pressure without getting defensive.
  You can write a brand narrative, not just design one.
  Fluent in Figma & in the Adobe suite.
  Experience with premium, luxury, or high AOV DTC brands. You understand why a $400 product needs different treatment than a $40 one.
  You work well remote. You communicate in writing, close loops, and don’t need checking on.
 
 Our values


 Act like an owner. Clarity over complexity. Serve clients’ best interest. We win together, we lose together. Data-informed, human-led.


 


 

    Perks and Benefits


 

 
  Paid time off
  Paid company holidays
  Flexible Fridays
  Remote first collaboration
  Quarterly performance bonus potential
